🇵🇭 Landslide hits Bukidnon province, Philippines (October 19, 2025)

🌧 On October 19, a landslide struck Bukidnon province on Mindanao Island, Philippines, following prolonged rainfall. Mud and rocks blocked roads and flooded homes in mountainous areas.

🚒 Local authorities deployed emergency crews to clear debris and assist affected residents. No official reports of casualties or injuries have been released.

📹 Footage from the scene shows damaged roads and flooded structures.

‼️🌍  Anomalous floods and landslides are happening more frequently around the globe. Almost every day, we report on several such occurrences. What is the reason? What does the statistics say? For answers to these questions and many others about the manifestation of natural disasters, read the report ON THE PROGRESSION OF CLIMATIC DISASTERS ON EARTH AND THEIR CATASTROPHIC CONSEQUENCES
